scope: Controller and metadata validation tests with a fake DOM/media; not rendering, narration synchronization, or real playback QA
mode: actual timing metadata; mocked media events, no encoded-media or browser QA

tests.name: The page is a Week 1 supplement with actual duration and no repeat submission
Default optional pauses preserve chapters 3 and 13 until Continue
Continue moves from the prediction to chapter 4 and from the attempt to check 14
A delayed playback event rewinds to the attempt before showing its check
Timer and animation-frame guards hold practice without a timeupdate event
Intentional chapter and native seeks do not trigger skipped optional pauses
Replaying a completed practice checkpoint reinstates its pause
Turning optional pauses off clears a held pause and permits continuous playback
A late natural end still catches an unfinished attempt; a final-check seek does not
All labels and downloadable transcripts describe demonstration chapters
Deep links and Previous/Next use exact chapter starts
Wide captions stay native; narrow captions use timed text below the image
Caption toggle disables both formats without duplicate mobile captions
Native video full screen uses native captions; wrapper full screen keeps captions below
Late caption loading attaches cue updates and desktop CC updates the toggle
Caption and video load failures provide readable fallbacks
Builder rejects unsafe pause tails, changed budgets and inconsistent timeline boundaries
